title: Bridge Communication Decoupling
summary: Established src/services/MCPClient as the single source of truth for SSE/JSON-RPC communication.
key_findings: Direct imports from extension.ts caused circular dependency failures in scripts and core logic.
conclusions: All mission commands MUST import getMCPClient from the services domain, not the entry point.
recommendations: Use absolute path aliases (@services) once the Phase 2 monorepo merge is complete.
